purpose: Recall-first selection using complementary saved Rosetta descriptors; preserve completed relaxation ablation

selection_constraint.source: User delegated numeric decision; 50% empirical inner-validation floor for exploratory pilot, not a held-out guarantee.

numeric_threshold: Selected independently per model and outer training set; no fixed value beyond p>=.5 diagnostic
descriptor_summary: Compute each feature median independently, retaining all three values, min/max/sample SD. This is not necessarily the feature vector of one conformer.
frozen_outer_splits: outer_splits.json; exact saved outer IDs and transfer exclusions

inner_validation.positive_family_limitation: Within-EGFR outer training fold 2 has only two families containing binders; each inner training partition contains only one binder-containing family.

threshold_policy.objective: maximize inner-validation recall subject to empirical precision >= 0.50
threshold_policy.selection_data: out-of-family inner validation predictions from outer training rows only; for transfer, source antigen only
threshold_policy.cutoffs: unique score blocks, prediction >= cutoff; no label-dependent tie splitting
threshold_policy.nonempty_requirement: Selecting nobody does not meet a precision constraint; precision is undefined. Report infeasible rather than weakening constraint.
threshold_policy.precision_caveat: An empirical training-validation precision floor does not guarantee held-out precision; report violations and family instability.
threshold_policy.raw_energy: Possible only with train-selected cutoff; zero REU is not assumed a binding cutoff.
threshold_policy.diagnostic_reference: P(B)>=0.5 on identical saved or newly fitted held-out predictions; changing only threshold does not change AUROC/AP/Brier/log loss.
tie_break: for model selection: fewer features then declared A,B,C,D,E order

comparison_rules: Evaluate all five prespecified sets separately at both coordinate stages.
Any preferred combination chosen only inside outer training; no global test-selected winner.
Retain historical FoldX-containing reference; do not attribute performance to a FoldX-free model.
Size controls: binder length and buried interface area. Size-normalized energy is separate.
Saved prior SC/Hbond and broad panel results remain retrospective historical references.
Within-target fold-weighted summaries, individual-fold curves and descriptive pooled metrics remain separate.
uncertainty: Per-fold and per-family support/variability reported. No confidence-interval or precision guarantee from empirical constraint, especially with sparse positive families.

missing_descriptors.status: separate proposal only, no scoring launched
missing_descriptors.interface_hydrophobicity: buried nonpolar SASA / total buried interface SASA; atom typing, SASA implementation, probe and partner accounting must be pinned and qualified. Distinct from hydrophobic-residue fraction and whole-binder exposed hydrophobicity.
missing_descriptors.unsatisfied_polar_groups: Bound-versus-separated delta under validated pinned implementation; existing DAlphaBall-dependent adapter result was unqualified/missing, not zero or biologically useless.
missing_descriptors.pilot_selection: Reuse six deterministic original length-spanning pilot IDs, one original and three existing relaxed coordinate files per case. No re-relaxation.
missing_descriptors.resources: CPU-only Slurm on scratch, conservative serial qualification, no shared environment replacement. Estimate measured incremental cost before expanding.
missing_descriptors.reason: Implementation/runtime qualification not yet performed. Prior worker overhead is not a valid DAlphaBall cost estimate.

limitations: Exact modeled sequences verified; assay construct equivalence remains unresolved.
Retrospective EGFR/TREM2 results do not calibrate a universal BCMA–B5 judge.
Rosetta REU is not experimental binding free energy or Kd.
Energy, H-bonds, solvation and packing descriptors are correlated, not independent physical measurements.

runtime.execution_note: Small CPU regression study runs locally in the exact original evaluator runtime after fresh CoreHPC SSH closed before staging. No cluster job submitted; no runtime installed or replaced. Historical prediction reproduction guard retained.

model_selection: Within each preparation stage and outer fold choose among A-E using only inner-validation recall, selected count, feature count and declared order. Report held-out selected-model outcomes including infeasible folds; no global test-selected winner.
coverage_policy: All 467 complete saved descriptors required. Stop on technical fitting/input/reproduction failures rather than silently imputing. For infeasible validation cutoffs keep ranking metrics and report classification coverage explicitly.
